aiOverview.content: As of late March 2026, 30-year FHA loan rates hover around 6.05% to 6.15%. Rates are competitive for borrowers with lower credit scores (down to 500-580) and 3.5% down payments. Bankrate lists the 30-year FHA rate at approximately 6.15%. Current FHA Loan Rate Trends (As of March 26, 2026) 30-Year Fixed FHA: 5.875% – 6.15% range 15-Year Fixed FHA: 5.75% – 5.85% range 30-Year FHA Refinance: Approximately 6.14% – 6.54% Key FHA Loan Considerations Down Payment: A minimum of 3.5% is required for credit scores of 580 or higher; 10% down is required for scores between 500 and 579. Mortgage Insurance Premium (MIP): FHA loans require an upfront premium of 1.75%, usually financed into the loan, plus monthly premiums ranging from 0.45% to 1.05%. Rate Factors: FHA rates are heavily influenced by daily bond market movements, inflation data, and Federal Reserve policy. Disclaimer: Rates change daily and depend on individual credit scores, loan-to-value ratios, and lender fees. Always check with multiple lenders for the best rate.
